settings.text_content: Premium Fire Shooting Replica | Film Accurate Resin, Core Weighted Balance & Dual Mode Safe Ignition

settings.content_1:
• Load: Insert a small piece of magical flash paper into the wand barrel.

  • Aim: Point the wand safely away from people, animals, and flammable objects.

  • Ignite: Press the hidden button on the handle to launch a spectacular fireball instantly.
settings.content_2:
• 1x Premium Magic Fire Wand (Resin & Metal Core)

  • 1x Luxury Ribbon-Lined Display Box

settings.content_3:
• Age Limit: Intended for adult collectors, cosplayers, and fans aged 18+.

  • Rechargeable: Built-in lithium battery—simply plug it in via USB when the ignition slows down.

  • Safe Handling: Never look down the barrel or point it at anyone while loaded.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.q1: How does the wand actually shoot fire?
settings.a1: The wand contains a built-in, rechargeable electric heating element. When you load a small piece of flash paper into the barrel and press the hidden button, it instantly ignites and launches a spectacular fireball.
settings.q2: Is it safe to use indoors?
settings.a2: Yes, when handled responsibly. It uses magic flash paper that burns up completely in mid-air within seconds, leaving zero smoke, sparks, or ash. Just ensure you never point it at people, pets, or flammable materials.
settings.q3: Does it come with a starter pack of flash paper?
settings.a3: Yes! Every wand includes a starter pack of flash paper sheets and a spell guide so you can practice your fire-casting right out of the box.
settings.q4: Is this a plastic toy? What is it made of?
settings.a4: Not at all. It is crafted from high-density, premium resin with a solid metal core running through the center. It has an authentic, movie-accurate heft that feels incredibly realistic in your hand.
settings.q5: How long does the battery last and how do I charge it?
settings.a5: It features a built-in lithium battery that is completely USB rechargeable no clunky batteries needed. A single full charge via the included cable gives you dozens of spectacular fireball launches.
settings.q6: What is the recommended age for this product?
settings.a6: Because it produces a real flame effect, this product is strictly intended for adult collectors, Harry Potter fans, and cosplayers aged 18 or older.
settings.q7: Can I use it as a regular display piece without shooting fire?
settings.a7: Absolutely. Even without being loaded, the intricate detail of the Elder Wand design and the premium, ribbon-lined luxury box make it a beautiful, classy display piece for any desk or shelf.
